question: How much of the frozen matched-band zero yield is forced by the integral chord slope condition before CRT coefficient selection?
input_policy: reuse all eight field records and all raw target-query rows of the frozen matched subgroup band panel without choosing fields or points anew
condition: For distinct integer lifted x coordinates, rational relation U+2V=O on a monic Weierstrass model with integral a1,a2 implies (y_U-y_V)/(x_U-x_V) is an integer
row_rule: count each reduced relation once; reconstruct centered integer point lifts from saved t pair and fixed public points; count integral slope, CRT acceptance, and rational relation as nested statuses
falsifier: any independently replayed rational-relation row with nonintegral chord slope, or a Lean counterexample to the stated algebraic bridge
claim_boundary: necessary filter for the frozen integral-a1-a2 and centered-point lift policy, not a bound over all rational models or alternative point lifts
